200.description:
Delivery fee quote for a Canadian street address (POST /api/v1/store/{n}/can-deliver, the order app's delivery eligibility check): the delivery fee, service fee rate, small order fee and its threshold, minimum order and estimated delivery time. Without `location_number` the delivering store is resolved first (POST /api/v1/search/find-delivery-store). No cart, order or payment is created. An address the site will not deliver to returns `fee_status: not_deliverable` with null fees.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `address_validated` | boolean | True when the site accepted the address for delivery. |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `delivery_address` | object | The address that was quoted, as sent. |
| `delivery_fee` | number | Courier delivery fee in CAD (deliveryFees.vendorFee). Null when no fee is published or the address is not deliverable. |
| `estimated_delivery_time` | string | Delivery estimate as the site words it, e.g. 33-38 min. |
| `fee_status` | string | available: a fee was quoted. not_published: the store accepted the address but returned no fee. not_deliverable: no store delivers to the address. |
| `lce_delivery_fee` | number | Additional Little Caesars delivery fee component (lceDeliveryFee), 0 when none. |
| `location_number` | number | Store that quoted the fee; null when no store delivers to the address. |
| `minimum_order_amount` | number | Minimum delivery subtotal (minimumDeliveryThreshold), 0 when none. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Milliseconds since the Unix epoch when this result was fetched. |
| `quote_type` | string |  |
| `service_fee_rate` | number | Service fee as a fraction of the order subtotal (lceServiceFee, 0.12 = 12%). |
| `small_order_fee` | number | Fee added to orders under small_order_fee_threshold, unless a promotion waives it. |
| `small_order_fee_threshold` | number | Subtotal under which the small order fee applies. |
| `source` | string | The endpoint that answered. |
| `status_message` | string | The site's message when the address is not deliverable. |
| `store_source` | string | Whether the store came from the input or was resolved from the address. |
